_note: The 1-minute agent rollup the detectors read (slide 18: 'roll up, then delete raw'). This repo uses Index Transform rather than Index Rollup for one reason: a Transform lets you NAME every output field, so the aggregation names below match slide 21's detector payload exactly and the detector runs verbatim. A Rollup target index uses internal names (gen_ai.agent.id.terms, http.request.body.size.sum) and relies on a search interceptor to rewrite queries - fine for hand-written searches, fragile for a plugin reading the index directly. The slide-faithful rollup job is in 61-rollup-agent-metrics-1m.json.
